pilot.title: Threats are not shown in pilot view
pilot.body: Switch to creator view to see the threat list and the crossings with the route.

crossing.title: Crossings with the route
crossing.note: Ranges are theoretical horizontal distances (metres from the reference table). Terrain, detection and engagement decisions are not modelled.
crossing.groupNote: A group that also has an unrecorded unit is judged by its reference range (the largest known). The range of the unrecorded unit is not used.
crossing.unrecordedNote: {{count}} threats with no recorded range are not included in the crossings.
crossing.noThreats: No threat can be used for crossings (only threats with a range in the reference table are used).
crossing.noFlights: No flights on the own side.
crossing.grazing: {{type}}: grazing, legs {{from}} to {{to}} (within 1 nm outside the range)
